summaryBullets: Download Android updates automatically from every app screen
Show each product's observed best-rate direction and last move
Reveal the individual products behind a selected bank move
Keep source and published app versions on one monotonic iteration

bullets.text: Android update checks now live at the app root, recheck when the app resumes, and start the system-managed download from any screen.
Release automation derives the next source version from the latest published APK, preventing stale branches from resetting the version sequence.
Product cards and details show the direction, size, and observed recency of the latest best-rate change when product history is available.
Selecting a bank move loads its product breakdown even when the separate market-history preference is off.
